title: Large language model-enabled automated data extraction for concrete materials informatics
abstract: arXiv:2604.22938v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The promise of data-driven materials discovery remains constrained by the scarcity of large, high-quality, and accessible experimental datasets. Here, we introduce a generalizable large language model (LLM)-powered pipeline for automated extraction and structuring of materials data from unstructured scientific literature, using concrete materials as a representative and particularly challenging example. The pipeline exhibits robust performance across a broad range of LLMs and achieves an $F_1$ score of up to 0.98 for diverse composition--process--property attributes. Within one hour, it extracts nearly 9,000 high-quality records with over 100 attributes from a corpus screened from more than 27,000 publications, enabling the construction of the largest open laboratory database for blended cement concrete. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的混凝土材料信息学自动化数据提取
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.22938v3 公告类型： replace-cross 摘要：数据驱动的材料发现的前景仍然受到大型、高质量且可获取的实验数据集稀缺的制约。在此，我们提出了一种可泛化的、由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的自动化流程，用于从非结构化的科学文献中提取并结构化材料数据，并以混凝土材料作为一个具有代表性且尤其具有挑战性的示例。该流程在广泛的大语言模型范围内均表现出稳健的性能，针对多样的组成—工艺—性能属性实现了高达0.98的F1分数。在一小时内，该流程从筛选自超过27,000篇出版物的语料库中提取了近9,000条包含100多个属性的高质量记录，从而构建了最大的掺合料水泥混凝土开放实验室数据库。机器学习分析强调了大型的、多样化的、信息丰富的数据集对于提升……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于大语言模型的可泛化自动化流程，能以高达0.98的F1分数从科学文献中提取混凝土材料的组成—工艺—性能数据，并据此构建了最大的掺合料水泥混凝土开放实验室数据库。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a generalizable LLM-powered pipeline that automatically extracts composition–process–property data of concrete materials from scientific literature with an F1 score of up to 0.98, enabling the construction of the largest open laboratory database for blended cement concrete.
